title: Drummers: Little Sheik, Red Happy and others
summary: Bailey names drummers he knew, including one who played at the Palace Theater, identified as Red Happy.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who were some of the outstanding drummers when you were young?

Well, well with Bob and Bob Aran and a little fella called Little Sheik used to play at the palace. He used to call him. And Little Big Big. I know you know him. He plays up and down all the time. Chinese Big Big.
Yeah, he is a good drum player.
Little Sheik used to play at the palace, huh?
Sheik, yeah. Sheik. That ain't the way to call him. This is, oh what's his name? He come up with Bob Barber and that he come up with. Yeah, happy. Happy.
That'd be red happy then they call him.
Yeah. You know there's two of them. Yeah, he used to take a drum truck there and beat it and show them sticks. Oh, he used to be at the palace theater here.
Who had the band there, do you remember?
I don't know who had the band, but I know the drum player was happy.
